captions.detailed: This object is a rectangular pop-up sunroof assembly consisting of a matte gray outer frame and a central tinted glass panel with a black perimeter border. The glass panel is designed to tilt upward from its rear edge, pivoting on a horizontal axis located at the front edge of the frame. Two small black guide shoe blocks are visible on the sides, intended to ride within corresponding channel tracks in the main frame assembly.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a pop-up ventilation sunroof cassette. It must feature a rectangular aluminum frame, a central glass panel with a dark border, and a revolute joint at the front edge allowing the panel to tilt upward at the rear, complete with guide shoes.
captions.factory: The code creates a base frame by subtracting a smaller centered box from a larger flat box to form the outer rectangular profile. The glass panel is constructed similarly as a thin box with a black border material and a central translucent glass material. A revolute articulation is defined at the front edge of the frame (modeled along the X-axis) to connect the frame to the glass panel, allowing the realistic upward tilting motion.
